tenants.SH-MS: <MS_TENANT> (CT or Preview, named by the user)
tenants.SH-OLD: a box below on-prem 26 on Preview (pre-dev-main24) or CT (CT-zinc-main24)

env.note: no DeployMate env: one run config per family (tenant = that family's shared tenant), generated with --families <F>

families.name: Partner PWA embedding on ct-zinc-master
families.note: sequential (one link state of antbe); owners' consent; attended (the operator types antbe's password in the iframe)

families.name: Microsoft ADFS / Entra logins on a registered tenant

families.note: GO / NO-GO for the manual Teams session

families.name: Beekeeper-mode simulation on CT (partner token + bridge shim)

families.name: Swap below on-prem 26 (second box)
families.note: owners' consent; Preview VPN; BLOCKED without a < 26 box

roles.rule: ct-zinc-master user antbe (embedding mock user, code_challenge_3); login name only
the PEP user of <MS_TENANT> whose e-mail equals the Microsoft test account (operator signs in to Microsoft)
a control password user of <MS_TENANT> for the restore check (runner's 0600 cred file)
swap owner on the < 26 box (runner's 0600 cred file)
swap candidate on the < 26 box, same personnel category as OLDHP1
HP of beekeeper-integration-tenant-test reached through a partner token (only after the decision)

changes.polyid_user_link: antbe's partner link on ct-zinc-master reset (PTN-10, PTN-11)
changes.restore: relinked by the scenario itself (state after PTN-11), or reset — as agreed with the owners

windows.note: doc windows/ct~W-SH-ANTBE with the owners' consent in reason; announced; nobody else uses the embedding mock with antbe meanwhile

changes.restore: the recorded type and settings (provider-read before / after)

windows.note: doc windows/ct~W-SH-MSTENANT with the owners' consent; everyone logging in to that tenant is affected; announced

gates.check: consents recorded in env-facts.md: owners of ct-zinc-master (antbe link reset, Teams read), of <MS_TENANT> (provider type window), of the < 26 box (swap writes); missing → that family BLOCKED 'no consent'

PWA prerequisites: POST <polyid-login>/api/auth/partner-sessions for challenge 3 / tenant ct-zinc-master answers 200 (LINKED or AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED; the token is discarded); 404 → PolyID partner missing, 403 → no UI_EMBEDDING → SH-PW BLOCKED (never edit the shared partner)

the user named <MS_TENANT>, its provider id, the Microsoft test account (secret store) and the PEP user with the same e-mail, and confirmed the Azure app registration lists /api/accept-login/<provider id>; else SH-MS BLOCKED 'no Microsoft test tenant'
the < 26 box: version read (< 26) on a Preview / CT host (never polypointservices.ch), VPN up if Preview, two HP logins in the runner's 0600 cred file; else SH-OLD BLOCKED 'no < 26 box'
Beekeeper token source decided (OQ-28) and the runner holds the entry URL; else SH-BEE BLOCKED

seed.note: consents, gates, cred files, per-family run configs; no data is seeded on a shared tenant

version_gate.else: BLOCKED 'no < 26 box' (DeployMate provisions only master and main-26)

cleanup: antbe left linked (state after PTN-11) or reset — as agreed with the ct-zinc-master owners
<MS_TENANT> provider type and settings restored (provider-read after = before)
the SWP-20 swap on the < 26 box cancelled
